patthana8.19:1.1: āsavavippayuttaṃ na sāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavavippayutto na sāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. āsavavippayuttaṃ na sāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavavippayutto na anāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. āsavavippayuttaṃ na āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavavippayutto na sāsavo ca āsavavippayutto na anāsavo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā.
patthana8.19:2.1: āsavavippayuttaṃ na anāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavavippayutto na anāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana8.19:3.1: āsavavippayuttaṃ na sāsavaṃ ca āsavavippayuttaṃ na anāsavaṃ ca dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavavippayutto na anāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana8.19:4.1: hetuyā pañca, ārammaṇe dve. avigate pañca, (sabbattha vitthāretabbaṃ.)
